violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Sides of equipment at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of food debris.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: No hot water provided at the three vat sink. Only cold water faucet is functional.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair three vat sink so that hot water at a minimum temperature of 110 degrees F is available.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. Missing/loose floor tiles observed in the area of the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. NOTE: Replace floor tiles as necessary to provide a smooth, nonslip, easily clean able surface that does not allow water to pond.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors throughout the kitchen area, especially at the cook line, has an accumulation of food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food, and to prevent the accumulation of food debris.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee dispose of dirty mop water then touch clean knives without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI washed hands sanitized knives

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: ware washing sink was not sanitized after dumping dirty mop water into it.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI sanitized with bleach water.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: all contents in standing refrigerator above 41f. Refrigerator temp 59f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI food discarded

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: standing refrigerator at 59f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DES PARDES RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 03/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Service Sink Available
violations.observation: There is no utility sink easily accessible for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes. Observed mop sink full of cleaning supplies and out of use.
violations.corrective_action: At least one service sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain shall be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. CDI service sink cleared.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mop Water Disposal
violations.observation: Observed that handwashing sinks, warewashing equipment, and/or food preparation sinks are being used to dispose mop water or similar wastes. Observed employee dump mop water in warewashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Dispose of mop water in a separate area to prevent contamination of food and food preparation and warewashing areas. CDI Ehs instructed to sanitize sink and dump water in mop sink.
